name: Greater Fireball Rune

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask

disable: DC 25 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune

items.name: Fireball
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

---

Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 4th-rank Fireball spell that deals 8d6 fire damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save).

text: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.
